notes: TROOP 0.3.7 remakes admin-flight angel wings with 182 layered high-detail feathers, curved asymmetric vanes, natural ivory shading, and articulated shoulder, elbow, wrist, and covert motion. The gentle wingbeat responds to climbing and gliding, stays smooth across multiplayer state updates, and uses six GPU-instanced render batches for stable performance. Multiplayer now strips forged non-admin flight states while preserving valid movement packets.
